summary: Provides a framework for IP fast-reroute mechanisms that protect against link or router failure by using repair paths decided locally. Unlike MPLS fast-reroute, it works with conventional IP routing and forwarding. It is informational.

eli5.summary: If a bridge closes, a driver with a backup route already in mind can turn immediately instead of waiting for news. This document describes how routers can have such backup routes ready.

questions: how do routers recover quickly from link failure
